title: kith-attach: tmp files created with process umask permissions (not 0o600)
description: write_blob and write_blob_streaming both use tokio::fs::File::create(&tmp_path) without setting file permissions. On a system with umask 0022 the temp file is created world-readable (0o644). A race between creation and rename means a local attacker can read the attachment content during that window. The backup.rs in kithctl correctly uses OpenOptions::new().mode(0o600) for the same reason. BlobStore should use OpenOptions with mode(0o600) for both the tmp file and consider verifying the rename destination also has restricted permissions.
